parts.text: {"summary":"You opened with a real image and stayed with it, which is the hard part; the middle drifted a little before the close pulled it back.","dimensions":[{"name":"Clarity","score":84,"note":"Every sentence landed cleanly, though the second one leaned on \"just\" twice."},{"name":"Confidence","score":79,"note":"The opening filler cost you the first beat; from \"nobody clapped\" onward you sounded settled."},{"name":"Pacing","score":88,"note":"Around 130 words a minute, and the pause after \"stayed late\" did real work."},{"name":"Vocal variety","score":71,"note":"The pitch flattened through the middle stretch where the detail was densest."},{"name":"Organization","score":86,"note":"Image, evidence, meaning, in that order, with nothing doubling back."},{"name":"Audience engagement","score":82,"note":"The specific name gave listeners someone to picture instead of a category."}],"tips":["Cut the opening \"um\" by taking the breath first and starting on the image.","Let the pitch move on the list of details; it flattened there.","Land the last word and stop, rather than trailing off into the silence."],"audienceImpact":"A listener comes away with one person they can see, which is more than most tributes manage in thirty seconds.","annotations":[{"index":0,"mark":"strong","note":"Concrete and unhurried; this is the line the whole piece rests on."},{"index":1,"mark":"flag","note":"Two short sentences in a row flattens the rhythm right where it should build."}],"strengths":["A specific person instead of an abstraction","A pause used deliberately, not filled"],"drills":[{"title":"Cold open","how":"Record the first sentence ten times with no run-up until it starts on the image."}]}
